findings.description: The night exterior (00:00-00:10) establishes a white sleeper semi parked at the lot with active exhaust vapor, implying an idling engine while the driver is inside. When the man exits at 01:43 he walks to a green box truck with a cold, vapor-free exhaust. No shot shows the white semi departing or the green truck arriving, so the parked vehicle's identity and physical state change discontinuously between night and morning without any depicted cause.
